title: Canonical finite geometric purity comparison data
statement:
Fix a purity datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], so $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, $k$ is its fixed algebraic closure, $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k_0)$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite and $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ with $n\ge1$. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be separated finite-type $k_0$-schemes and $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ a separated finite-type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Let $X,Y,f$ be their geometric base changes, and let $g_X,g_Y$ be the geometric-Frobenius scheme automorphisms of [def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius], with $g_X\,;f=f\,;g_Y$. Assume $f$ is smooth of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the fixed-scalar derived categories $C_T=D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},\operatorname{Mod}A)$ and their canonical intrinsic realization equivalences from [def-pur-conventions]; put $Q_T=Lg_T^*$.

Define the following coordinate maps, retaining those realization equivalences and their units. The compact-support functor $F$ is $Rf_!$ at the same finite-type compactification used by the smooth-purity construction, and $G=Rf^!$ is the specified exceptional inverse image of [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Its counit $\varepsilon_K:FGK\to K$ is the specified bounded-below counit on bounded-below objects, extended by zero outside that domain. The purity isomorphism $\Gamma_K:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}GK$ for $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ is exactly [def-pur-smooth-purity-map] transported by intrinsic realization, including both realization units, not a new choice of orientation. The source comparison $b_K:Q_X(Lf^*K(d)[2d])\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf^*(Q_YK)(d)[2d]$ is the tensor, shift and roots-of-unity comparison of [def-pur-tate-datum], using the actual semilinear commuting square; equivalently it is the root-chart formula independent of the primitive root, before applying a Weil isomorphism. The auxiliary domain witness is preservation of the finite-Tor constructible predicate by $Q_Y$. Finally $B_M:Q_YFM\to FQ_XM$ is the proper/open exchange of [def-exchange-projection], transported back to the retained compactification on the bounded-below etale-origin domain used by [def-pur-compact-support-transport], and extended by zero off that domain. These definitions specify the maps and their normalizations; they assert none of the purity, counit, trace or adjunction-mate equivariance equations.
